alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (ResourceNotFoundException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: The specified log group does not exist.

root_cause.hypothesis: Checkout service alarm likely tripped on near-zero CPU utilization (~0.005%) while a deployment is in-flight — tasks match desired count and none are pending/failed, so this isn't a capacity or rollout failure. Pattern suggests running tasks aren't processing traffic (stuck rollout drain, health-check-only tasks, or upstream traffic not reaching service) rather than resource exhaustion.
evidence: tasks_running == tasks_desired == 2, tasks_pending == 0 → no scheduling/capacity problem
deployments_in_flight == 1 → active deployment mid-progress at alarm time
cpu_utilization_pct ~0.0047% → essentially idle, abnormal for a live checkout service
memory_utilization_pct ~58.6% → normal range, not a memory-pressure event
RECENT DEPLOYS empty and LOGS empty → limited corroborating evidence
ruled_out: Task capacity shortage (running == desired, no pending)

proposal.reasoning: Tasks match desired (2/2), none pending/failed, mem normal (~59%), but CPU near-zero (~0.005%) with a deployment in-flight yet RECENT DEPLOYS empty and no logs available. Contradictory/insufficient telemetry for checkout (revenue-critical) — can't confirm stuck rollout vs traffic-routing issue vs benign idle. Blind restart/rollback on a payment path without log confirmation risks masking or worsening a checkout outage.
proposal.expected_effect: On-call gets alerted with current metrics to pull ALB target health, task logs, and deployment status before any state-changing action is taken on checkout.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
